title: Siman 307
section: The Virtue of Those Who Drew Close to Him

segments.he: פַּעַםאַחַת הָיָה אֶצְלוֹ מְחֻתָּנוֹ רַבִּי לֵיבּ מִדָּאבְּרָאוְונֶע וְנִפְטַר מִמֶּנּוּ וְקִבֵּל רְשׁוּת כַּנָּהוּג עָנָה וְאָמַר יֵשׁ לִי בַּת בִּקְרִימִינְטְשַׁאק (לָאזְט זִי גְּרִיסְן
segments.en: (17.) I heard in his name that he said: "I have nothing whatsoever to do in this world — for for my own sake I need to do nothing at all. Only I came into the world to draw the souls of Israel close to Hashem Yisburach. But I can only draw close those who come to me and tell me their deficiency — those I can rectify with a rectification that no one else can make etc."
